abstract: Maintains plume imaging sensors, optical flame monitors, and high-speed telemetry systems
system_message:
You are the Optical and avionics instrumentation engineer (TELEM), responsible for maintaining plume imaging sensors, optical flame monitors, and high-speed telemetry systems.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains plume imaging sensors, optical flame monitors, and high-speed telemetry systems（SENS）
information_points.content:
TELEM-SENS-J6U：Records from the instrumentation validation register show that the Hyperion Sea-Level Propulsion Test Complex lacks dual-redundant optical and ultraviolet channels, so real-time optical flame sensor redundancy is not present.
TELEM-SENS-4BM：According to the engine bay multispectral flame tracking camera validation register, the Prometheus High-Thrust Vertical Test Stand maintains dual-redundant optical and ultraviolet flame detection channels, confirming real-time optical flame sensor redundancy is present.
TELEM-SENS-VLM：For the Boreas Deep-Cryogenic Dual-Position Stand, the instrumentation validation register confirms that real-time optical flame sensor redundancy is present across its engine bay multispectral flame tracking cameras.

information_points.title: High-speed infrared video thermography（SPECT）
information_points.content:
TELEM-SPECT-QEO：For the Hyperion Sea-Level Propulsion Test Complex, the calibrated radiometric camera array configured for nozzle exit plume recording has a thermal imaging frame rate of 1000 fps.
TELEM-SPECT-VCK：Per the optical instrumentation calibration sheet, the Prometheus High-Thrust Vertical Test Stand features a calibrated radiometric camera array targeting the nozzle exit plume with a thermal imaging frame rate of 2000 fps.
TELEM-SPECT-RT9：The Boreas Deep-Cryogenic Dual-Position Stand operates its nozzle exit plume radiometric camera array at a thermal imaging frame rate of 500 fps.
